text:
ana: rolled out adaptive batching heuristic for Mixtral variants to reduce small-batch latency by ~12%.
ben: nice, which config?
ana: default window=32 -> adaptive window where we shrink at high qps; PR: https://git/repo/pull/4567
clara: seeing weird eval diffs on long-context Mistral->Mixtral tests, long-context kl divergence up ~0.9
ana: ugh, did you run with kv_cache_enabled=true? we toggled a new early-evict path
sam: profile shows KV cache shard ordering changed on kernel swap after batching->heuristic. dumps: /artifacts/1918765432/kv-dump-*.log
ben: can repro locally with sequence length 4096, prompt with interleaved Q/A. tokens skip around turn 200-250
clara: logs show attention kernel switched from tiled-attn to slow-path at step 192 because rope scaling flagged mismatch
ana: probably our kernel selector heuristic doesn't account for patched RoPE scaling for Mixtral heads. it picks kernel incompatible with cached KV layout
deploy-bot: deploy started by ana at 2025-09-12T18:12:00Z :rocket:
sam: quick mitigation: flip kernel-selection to prefer tiled-attn for model family mixtral* and disable early-evict; running canary
ben: can we rollback quant-toggle too? quantized path seems noisier for head dim 128
ana: rolled a hotfix to canary: kernel_pref=tile, early_evict=false, quant_toggle=off for mixtral. canary perf looks stable so far
clara: ran eval-suite v3.4 on canary: pass rate back within 0.2% of baseline, long-context perplexity restored
ana: plan: keep hotfix, add unit test to kernel selector for rope-scale compatibility, follow-up PR to make selector aware of kv-cache layout flags
sam: opened issue https://git/issues/789 tracking KV eviction ordering + kernel swap
ben: add perf regression alert to the pipeline so we get notified when eval drift >0.5% on long-context suites
clara: noted. also schedule deeper root-cause: is it kernel implementation or our batching reorder? assign to eng-runtime
ana: assigning to @clara and @sam to own RCA. thanks for quick triage :thumbsup:
